scope: TriviaQA gold-donor source/style-matched control; canonical reported hidden-state result is fixed original-direction transfer, not a control refit.

gold_donor_construction.donor_selection_algorithm: Seeded greedy, rarity-first assignment within each split: prefer exact (number_kind, case_kind, whitespace-token-count) bucket, then coarse (number_kind, case_kind), then any eligible unused donor; choose minimum profile-match cost with seeded tie-break.
gold_donor_construction.alias_overlap_filter: Normalized donor answer must not equal any normalized target gold alias or target true answer.
gold_donor_construction.exact_string_overlap_filter: Normalized donor answer must be nonempty and must not occur as the normalized target question string; no separate substring-overlap filter is implemented.
gold_donor_construction.answer_type_matching: Preferred, not absolute: number_kind (year/numeric/contains_digit/none) and case_kind are bucket keys; global fallback may relax them.
gold_donor_construction.length_matching: Preferred, not absolute: exact whitespace-token-count is the first bucket; token-count distance and character-length difference enter the donor cost.

answer_only_style_classifier.train_test_split: Preserved pair split: train=2,499 pairs and held-out test=2,500 pairs; no resplitting.
answer_only_style_classifier.class_balance: Exactly balanced in each split: each pair contributes one true/gold label=1 and one false/donor label=0.
answer_only_style_classifier.input: Answer strings only. Questions, prompts, hidden states, and model outputs are excluded; true and false answers are independent classifier samples.

semantic_audit.sampling_population: All 4,999 completed target--donor assignments, sampled without replacement.
semantic_audit.reviewers: One user-performed manual review; reviewer identity is not recorded in the artifact.
semantic_audit.audit_criterion: For each sampled target question, the donor gold answer was judged semantically false (i.e., not a correct answer to that target question).
